# Bitcoin Midday Brief — April 28

**BTC holding $76k despite light selling pressure.** Down point-seven percent over twenty-four hours — nothing dramatic, but we're watching the fear gauge. Fear and Greed at 33, deep into fear territory. That's where opportunities hide.

**On-chain picture stays solid.** Hashrate hovering near 927 exahashes — network security locked in. Mempool's clean at under 67k transactions, fees bottomed at 3 sats per byte. No congestion, no panic.
